about: The English Wikipedia article pages scripts/sync-fiba-results.mjs reads FIBA's men's national-team results from (scripts/data/fiba-results.json), each pinned at the revision read: npm run sync:fiba-results -- --fetch downloads a page missing from data-src/fiba-results/ (its /wiki/ path, through scripts/lib/polite-fetch.mjs), --pin records what was downloaded. A tournament's hosts are its host cities' countries, as its article names them: a host nation plays at home there, everyone else at a neutral venue.

source.licence: CC BY-SA 4.0 (the articles' text and tables); the results themselves are facts
source.terms: robots.txt allows /wiki/ for every agent this project's requests answer to (ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai among them); read 2026-11-21 through scripts/lib/polite-fetch.mjs, one page at a time
